adapters.name: TCNRUL
adapters.rationale: Provide a lightweight convolutional RUL baseline under the shared RUL contract.
adapters.risks: Framework-oriented implementation; it must not be presented as a paper-exact or SOTA model.

adapters.name: PatchTSTRUL
adapters.rationale: Reuse the admitted patch-based representation as a scalar RUL adapter.
adapters.risks: The RUL pooling head is framework-specific and is not a claim of paper-equivalent performance.

adapters.name: TransformerRUL
adapters.rationale: Provide a transparent full-attention control model for RUL comparisons.
adapters.risks: Quadratic sequence cost; intended as a baseline rather than a high-efficiency default.

adapters.name: CBAMTCNDetector
adapters.source: CBAM (ECCV 2018) combined with a causal one-dimensional TCN
adapters.rationale: Evaluate CBAM as a reusable sequence-attention component without presenting it as a standalone anomaly-detection paper model.
adapters.risks: Framework-oriented task adapter; performance depends on the TCN forecasting head and must not be attributed to CBAM alone.
